text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- MP Jassem al-Kharafi asks parliament to seek constitutional court ruling to resolve dispute over speaker. Opposition vetran Ahmad al-Saadoun was elected last month parliament speaker but his opponent Kharafi said the vote procedure was unconstitutional.
- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) officials say time is right for OPEC to consider a higher oil quota for Kuwait. OPEC ministers meet later in November.
- Kuwait's Securities House considers investing in other Arab markets.
- Internet providers soon to operate under Communications Ministry.
- United Nations oil experts end mission in Iraq.
